item.title: Expired plate found in Elliot Lake
item.description: A driver faces several charges after a traffic stop last Friday in Elliot Lake. His temporary licence plate was expired on his pickup truck, Ontario Provincial Police say. David Brandon Canavan, 33, of Elliot Lake, was charged with drive motor vehicle, no currently validated permit, operate unsafe vehicle, insecure load and fail to have insurance […]

item.title: Brady Martin returns, Soo Greyhounds hold off Windsor Spitfires
item.description: Captain returns after five-week absence as Greyhounds lean on early push and Carter George to edge Windsor 5-2.

item.title: WestJet adds Sault Ste. Marie to Calgary summer service
item.description: WestJet will be flying from Sault Ste. Marie to Calgary this summer. The airline is expanding its domestic network with new non-stop summer service. North Bay and Campbell River, British Columbia (YBL) will also be added to the new summer service along with non-stop seasonal service between Terrace, B.C., and Edmonton, strengthening domestic connectivity […]

item.title: Algoma residents invited to help shape the future of public health
item.description: Algoma Public Health wants the community to help guide the organization’s priorities over the next several years. It has launched an anonymous online survey to gather information on important public health care matters. item.title: Sault Ste. Marie faces bed, staffing losses under provincial funding plan, CUPE warns

item.title: Soo Greyhounds dodge major blow as Chase Reid out day-to-day
item.description: Upper-body injury will keep the highly-touted 2026 NHL Draft prospect sidelined past Wednesday's game against Sudbury.
